opening.quote: Good after noon, Tidewell Home, Femke speaking. How can I help?
opening.comment: The agent gave the company name and her own name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Customer: Order number. Customer: 903617. Agent: Okay, I've cancelled 903617 for the large duvet.
verification.comment: The agent acted on the order without confirming the caller's full name or a postcode, so verification was skipped before the order was changed.

understanding.quote: Customer: Wait, no, I didn't want to cancel all have it. I just wanted to change the size two medium. what I meant.
understanding.comment: The caller clearly wanted a size change, but the agent cancelled the order and dismissed the correction, so the actual issue was not captured.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: this order been dispatched, so cancelling is free, and the €69.00 goes back to your card in um 3 to 5 working daze.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says cancellations are free only before dispatch, so saying the order was dispatched and cancelling is free is incorrect, and the refund timeline is the only accurate part.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: You'll have to border the medium again yourself.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred, so the hold step does not apply, but the agent cancelled an order based on a misread request, which is a process failure in handling the change.

communication.quote: Agent: You saids cancel. It's cancelled. You'll have to border the medium again yourself.
communication.comment: The caller said she was panicked and the agent was dismissive and did not acknowledge her concern, so communication fell short.

closing.quote: Agent: Thank you for calling Tidewell. Goodbye.
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and confirmed the cancellation email, but she did not clearly explain the next steps for the wrong-size order.
